sections.Profile:
The "West Show" pinball machine, produced by Italian manufacturer A.M.I. in 1976, is a single-player electro-mechanical game with a Western theme. The playfield features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, a 4-bank drop target, six standup targets, and a ball kicker.

- Manufacturer: A.M.I.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Wedgehead, 1970s, Single level playfield
